name: Self Doubt
overview: Scripture affirms that God created humanity in His own image, giving each person inherent worth and purpose (Genesis 1:27). In moments of self-doubt, believers are encouraged to trust in God's sustaining presence and promises, for He strengthens, helps, and upholds His people (Isaiah 41:10). Confidence is found by fixing our minds on God, who grants perfect peace to those who trust Him (Isaiah 26:3), and by remembering that His plans for us are for good and hope-filled outcomes (Jeremiah 29:11). The Bible calls us to reject fear and discouragement, embracing our God-given identity and the assurance that we are known and valued (Ruth 3:11).
